question: Good evening, Professor Cat. Thanks for the hard work you're always doing. Currently Subaru has lost his memory, too, and so Joshua is in a state where no one at all remembers him correctly, but if you don't mind, please tell me about his current situation and the reaction of those in the environment surrounding him.
answer: In Priestella, there were many people who were struck with the same condition as Joshua, so I think they'd gather them all together and let them sleep. It's very sad to say, but nothing changes when you let them sleep on the floor, so it's easier to manage putting them all together. No one knows him, so there's no reaction or anything.
